name: voicedraft
idea: VoiceDraft is a browser-based, real-time voice transcription pad powered by the Web Speech API — users speak and their words appear instantly, with session history, multi-format export, and 13+ language support, all 100% client-side. It targets remote workers, note-takers, journalists, and anyone who types slower than they speak.
why_trending: Voice-to-text and meeting productivity tools dominate Product Hunt June 2026 — Mina Meeting Assistant received 479,135 votes making it the #2 product of the month, and Wispr Flow (voice dictation) is a featured trending product. The AI meeting assistants market is projected to hit $7.33B by 2035. People are actively searching for free browser-based alternatives to paid tools like Otter.ai and Whisper.
why_profitable: Freemium model: free tier with session history capped at 5, paid Pro ($7/month) removes limits and adds cloud sync and speaker diarization. Alternatively, Google AdSense on the free tier monetises the large search traffic for 'free voice to text online'. Comparable tools (Otter.ai at $16.99/mo, Whisper-based SaaS at $10-30/mo) prove strong willingness to pay.
why_easy: The Web Speech API (window.SpeechRecognition / window.webkitSpeechRecognition) is fully built into Chrome, Edge, and Safari — zero backend, zero API keys, zero cost. The entire app is a single index.html with vanilla JS: transcription, localStorage session persistence, and file-download exports all run 100% in the browser with no server required.
note: Repo pepegoat/voicedraft needs to be manually created on GitHub — the GitHub App token in this session lacks repo-creation (Administration) permission. The full working demo is committed at demo/voicedraft/index.html in this repo and should be moved once the target repo exists.
